key_insight: A symmetry-aware template framework lets researchers rapidly model composition-dependent distortions in ABO3 perovskites, revealing how symmetry breaking changes structure-property relationships across low- and high-symmetry phases.
engineering_relevance: This provides a faster, lower-cost route to screen realistic perovskite structures and their properties, which can improve materials design for energy applications such as solar cells.
method: Built symmetry-constrained templates for low-/high-symmetry structures
Used unconstrained supercell templates to capture multiple distortion modes
Surveyed 15 representative compositions to map links between composition, supercell size, shape, and distortions
evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic exploration of 15 representative compositions and use of the resulting structural insights to propose a rapid, computationally inexpensive protocol.
watch_item: The approach still depends on template choices and supercell setup, so uncommon distortion patterns may require larger or more specialized cells to capture reliably.
paper_title: Mapping the influence of symmetry breaking in structure-property relationships of ABO$_3$ perovskites
